title: Acceptance Baseline Snapshot (W8-A4)
description: Immutable snapshot materialized by the freeze-acceptance-baseline kernel node. Carries the canonical AC artifact ids + per-artifact accepted hashes + the computed baselineHash. The SRS author node (HOW side) reads this snapshot after domain.frozen. Concrete codec registered by Wave 2/3 ContractSchemaRegistry behind this id.

baselineHash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of the accepted AC set (sorted by artifact id).
